vocabulary.meaning_en: used to agree, to ask or give permission, or to say something is acceptable but not great
vocabulary.note_ar: في الكتابة الرسمية اكتب okay، وفي الرسائل غير الرسمية يكثر OK
vocabulary.note_en: Write "okay" in formal writing; "OK" is common in casual texts.
vocabulary.example: Is it okay if I sit here?

vocabulary.meaning_en: enough; it works but it is not the best
vocabulary.example: The food was sufficient, but not great.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when someone says you are allowed to do something
vocabulary.example: You need permission to leave early.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a strong promise or wish to do something

vocabulary.example: Can I call you later? - Absolutely.

vocabulary.note_ar: شائعة جدًا في بريطانيا بمعنى ممتاز
vocabulary.note_en: Very common in British English for "excellent".

vocabulary.note_ar: يفتح باب الحديث لأن السامع سيسأل: لماذا؟
vocabulary.note_en: It makes people ask more questions.
vocabulary.example: How was your day? - Interesting! I got a job offer.
Saying "I'm okay" can create unnecessary worry.
There is no cause for concern.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something people do because it is normal and polite in society
vocabulary.example: "How are you?" is a social convention.

vocabulary.note_ar: That's not okay = غير مقبول إطلاقًا
vocabulary.example: Shouting at your mother is unacceptable.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a strong feeling of excitement and interest

fine_lines.title: "How are you?" - "I'm okay" vs "I'm good"
fine_lines.explanation_ar: إذا سألك أحد How are you? لا تقل I'm okay لأن المتحدث الأصلي سيظن أن هناك مشكلة. قل I'm good / I'm great / I'm well / Fine, thank you. لكن بعد سقوط أو حادث تقول I'm okay أي لم أُصب بأذى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: When someone asks "How are you?", don't say "I'm okay"; it sounds like something is wrong. Say I'm good / great / well / fine, thanks. After a fall or accident, "I'm okay" is fine: it means "I'm not hurt".

examples.sentence: Hi Tom, how are you? - I'm good, thanks!
Did you hurt yourself? - No, I'm okay.

fine_lines.title: "I'm good" (answer) vs "I'm good" (refusal)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I'm good جوابًا على How are you تعني أنا بخير. لكن جوابًا على دعوة (Do you want to see a movie?) تعني: لا، شكرًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I'm good" after "How are you?" means I'm fine. After an invitation it means "No, thanks".

examples.sentence: Do you want more cake? - I'm good, thanks.

expressions.meaning_en: strong ways to say yes to an invitation
expressions.example: Do you want to see a film later? - Why not?

expressions.meaning_ar: إنه رائع / مذهل / ممتاز / مثير للاهتمام.

expressions.phrase: Are you sure it's okay if...? / Is it alright if...?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل أنت متأكد أنه لا مانع إن...؟ / هل لا بأس إن...؟
expressions.example: Is it alright if I take next Monday off?

expressions.phrase: Go ahead. / Of course. / No problem.
expressions.example: Can I leave 20 minutes early? - No problem. Go ahead.
How are you today? - I'm great, thanks.
Talking to people like that is not okay.

expressions.meaning_ar: حسنًا... (سأفعل لكن على مضض) / آه فهمت الآن
expressions.meaning_en: I'll do it but I don't want to; or: now I understand
expressions.example: Clean your room. - Okay... (I don't want to.)

questions.question: "How are you?" Which answer is best?
questions.explanation_ar: لا تقل I'm okay لأنها توحي بوجود مشكلة.
questions.explanation_en: "I'm okay" sounds like something is wrong.

questions.question: "Do you want to see a movie later?" Show enthusiasm:
questions.explanation_en: "Why not?" shows you're happy to go.

questions.question: "Can I leave 20 minutes early to get my child?" A good boss says:
questions.explanation_ar: No problem. Go ahead تعطي إذنًا حقيقيًا.
questions.explanation_en: "No problem. Go ahead" gives real permission.

questions.question: "How is the weather today?" (British, very good)
questions.explanation_en: Brilliant means excellent in British English.

questions.question: "How was your day?" Which answer makes people want to talk more?
questions.explanation_ar: interesting تجعل الآخر يسأل: ماذا حدث؟

questions.question: "That is not okay!" means:
questions.explanation_ar: That is not okay = غير مقبول.

questions.question: Tom falls down. "Are you alright?" The natural answer is:
questions.explanation_ar: بعد حادث، I'm okay تعني لم أصب بأذى.
questions.explanation_en: After an accident, "I'm okay" = not hurt.

questions.question: "Do you want more tea?" - "I'm good, thanks." This means:
questions.explanation_ar: I'm good جوابًا على عرض تعني لا شكرًا.
questions.explanation_en: After an offer, "I'm good" means no, thanks.

questions.question: Why is "Okay" a weak answer to an invitation?
questions.explanation_en: It doesn't show you really want to go.

questions.question: Which asks for real permission?
choices: Is it alright if I take your book?
questions.explanation_ar: Is it alright if...? طلب إذن حقيقي.
questions.explanation_en: "Is it alright if...?" asks for real permission.
